summary: Iteration 17 (SESIÓN 7 SRI Match) testing complete. All 12 backend pytest tests PASSED covering counters, exact match, approx match, confirm/reject, mark-cash (factura→efectivo creates linked tx, consumo→con_respaldo without new tx), link-manual, discard, corporate toggle, scan, pending shape, and deduction-limits. Frontend smoke verified Dashboard widget 4 counters, /sri-match page with tabs and rescan, Match SRI sidebar navigation, and uso-empresarial-toggle conditionally rendered (visible for expense, hidden for income). Hooks in POST /api/transactions correctly trigger try_sri_match + retry_pending automatically.
passed_tests: POST /api/transactions (consumo without invoice) → estado_sri=pendiente_match with match_pendiente_hasta deadline set
Exact match (±2%) factura+consumo → both estado_sri=con_respaldo with mutual factura_vinculada_id/consumo_vinculado_id
Approx match (~7%, within 10%) → both estado_sri=match_aproximado with match_aproximado_candidato_id and confianza
GET /api/sri/pending returns {match_aproximado, sin_respaldo_72h} enriched with candidato
POST /api/sri/confirm-match/{id} promotes match_aproximado → con_respaldo on both sides
POST /api/sri/reject-match/{id} reverts both sides to pendiente_match with new 72h deadline and clears links
POST /api/sri/mark-cash/{id} on factura creates new efectivo consumo (payment_method=efectivo, estado_sri=con_respaldo) and cross-links
POST /api/sri/mark-cash/{id} on consumo marks con_respaldo without creating new tx
PATCH /api/sri/corporate/{id} sets uso_empresarial=true and is_deductible=false; counters exclude corporate tx
Frontend Dashboard renders 4 counter widgets (counter-con-respaldo, counter-aproximado, counter-pendiente, counter-sin-vincular) all visible
Frontend /sri-match page (sri-match-page) with tabs (tab-aprox, tab-sin) and rescan-btn functional
Frontend sidebar navItem 'Match SRI' present and routes to /sri-match
Frontend Transactions add dialog uso-empresarial-toggle visible only for expense (hidden when income)
critical_code_review_comments: sri_match.py: clean module (~330 lines) with sensible tolerances (EXACT 2%, APPROX 10%, DATE 7d, PENDING 72h). Mutual link update + candidate scoring by min diff_pct works correctly.
_find_candidate excludes already-linked (factura_vinculada_id/consumo_vinculado_id) and con_respaldo candidates, preventing double-binding.
retry_pending_matches uses ISO string comparison for deadline; works because deadlines are always UTC ISO. Acceptable.

discard endpoint clears match_pendiente_hasta but does NOT clear factura_vinculada_id/consumo_vinculado_id - if a tx was previously linked and then discarded, the orphan link remains on counterpart. Minor data hygiene improvement opportunity, not blocking.
uso-empresarial-toggle hidden for income (correct). Backend toggle_corporate auto-sets is_deductible=false when uso_empresarial=true; verified.
demo user lacks canEdit and cannot open Nueva transacción dialog (admin-only). Tested with admin user as workaround. This is by-design; demo mode is read-only.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_sri_match_session7.py - Created comprehensive pytest suite for SRI Match feature
